name: example
base: <the commit the tasks were made at>
setup: git clone <repo> clone; npm ci in clone; git worktree add <worktrees>/<slot> <base> per run slot; ln -s clone/node_modules into each worktree; echo node_modules >> clone/.git/info/exclude. Copy this file to <name>.json (any name but example), then python3 bench/repo_fix/make_tasks.py --repo <name> --worktree <worktrees>/mk. The file, the tasks and the receipts stay local (.gitignore).
